title: A $4,200 Diamond's Lab Twin Now Costs $380
hook: The same-looking diamond now costs $380 instead of $4,200.
closing: When identical-looking stones diverge this much, buyers start questioning what rarity is worth.
question: Natural or lab-grown?

segments.say: In 2023, a lab-grown diamond cost $1,400. The price halved in one year, then nearly halved again.
A natural one-carat diamond costs $4,200; a lab-grown one costs $380. That is about eleven times less.
By 2024, 47 percent of US engagement rings used lab-grown centers. In 2018, only 3 percent did.
